name: France
summary: France, Day 241. Diplomacy abroad, crisis at home. Foreign Minister Barrot joined the R4+E3+Italy meeting in Istanbul (23 Oct) that opposed a new strike on Iran. At home, riots (17 and 24 Oct), a 10Y OAT above 5% and a ~150–170bp spread to Bunds make France the euro area's main market risk before the 3-Nov budget vote. No direct France–Iran channel; the French carrier has not entered Hormuz.

recent_signals.headline: France: domestic crisis is now a market event — riots 17 and 24 Oct, 70,000 police, 10Y OAT >5% (24-year high), OAT–Bund ~150–170bp; Moody's affirmed Aa3 (23 Oct); budget vote 3 Nov. Barrot in Istanbul (23 Oct, R4+E3+Italy): escalation 'would create nothing but losers… very serious consequences for hydrocarbon prices'. Macron plans a post-election LAF conference. (CONFIRMED; intel ISR-B3, DIP-B2)

**France: Macron pledged 'soldiers, radars and defence systems' for Yanbu (24–25 Sep); as G7 president announced the 100mb stock release (2 Oct) after Trump threatened to halt US diesel exports to Europe; condemned the 'heinous' Riyadh attack (11 Oct); says no Russian 'energy truce' seen (12 Oct).** French OAT–Bund spread 154bp (2 Oct, widest since 2011). No French CSG position reported in October; no French-flag vessel hit. — CONFIRMED.
**France threatened to summon Iran's ambassador after Tehran closed a French-embassy-affiliated language centre (Reuters, 21 Sep).** Minor bilateral friction; no operational content. — REPORTED.

FRANCE CHARLES DE GAULLE CSG TRANSITED SUEZ TO RED SEA / GULF OF ADEN FOLLOWING CMA CGM SAN ANTONIO STRIKE — FIRST EUROPEAN NAVAL SHIFT OF CYCLE; MACRON CALLED FOR HORMUZ REOPENING AND SPOKE WITH IRANIAN PRESIDENT PEZESHKIAN. CMA CGM San Antonio (Maltese-flagged, Philippine crew, French-owned shipping group) struck by cruise missile in Hormuz May 5; multiple crew injured. CBS attribution to Iran (single-source US officials, IRGC has NOT claimed). Macron: 'France is in no way under attack' (leveraged Maltese-flag technicality) while deploying CSG. The simultaneity (deploying force while denying attack) mirrors Iranian 'negotiate while bombing' pattern. The National UAE frames as Hormuz-reopening tailwind supportive of UAE position. ABC: French CSG specifically moved south of Suez 'ahead of conditional UK-French Hormuz mission.'
